title.zh: 爱丽丝维柚 · 物理染色与三蓄合轴
title.en: Alice / Velina / Yuzuha · Physical color and triple-charge overlap

summary.zh: 柚叶刷新后由爱丽丝染物理，维琳娜按风华补气旋并回支；爱丽丝常态南十字、失衡北十字，满剑仪再三蓄。
summary.en: After Yuzuha refreshes, Alice colors Physical. Velina restores Cyclone using Windbloom and assists back; Alice uses South Cross outside Stun, North Cross during it, and triple-charges only with full Sword Etiquette.

conditions.zh: 循环站位爱丽丝→维琳娜→柚叶，可整体旋转；柚下切、维上切都接主攻。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Alice→Velina→Yuzuha, with equivalent rotations; Yuzuha assists next and Velina previous to the main attacker.

conditions.zh: 依据作者3.0明确队伍流程，角色机制以固定3.3正式源为准；乱流、紊乱及普通强击按实际触发分别判断。
conditions.en: Uses the author’s explicit 3.0 team flow with fixed release 3.3 mechanics; evaluate Vortex, Disorder and ordinary Assault as their actual distinct triggers.

conditions.zh: 教学适用于固定Gachabase正式3.3基础技能；默认0影无专武，不启用潜能觉醒。
conditions.en: Uses fixed Gachabase release 3.3 base skills; M0 without signatures by default, with no Potential awakening.

conditions.zh: 按实际资源、敌人异常、失衡与提示执行；没有固定秒数、帧数、连携次数或最高分承诺。
conditions.en: Follow actual resources, Anomaly, Stun and prompts; no fixed seconds, frames, Chain count or maximum-score claim.

label.zh: Asgater · 维简／爱柚维操作（3.0）
label.en: Asgater · Jane/Alice with Velina and Yuzuha (3.0)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 维琳娜风华与气旋（3.0）
label.en: Orange · Velina Windbloom and Cyclones (3.0)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 爱丽丝剑仪与三蓄（2.1）
label.en: Orange · Alice Sword Etiquette and triple charge (2.1)

label.zh: 爱丽丝 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Alice · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 维琳娜 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Velina · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.en: Yuzuha · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 爱丽丝 · 专属音擎固定源
label.en: Alice · fixed signature source

label.zh: 维琳娜 · 专属音擎固定源
label.en: Velina · fixed signature source

label.en: Yuzuha · fixed signature source

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先染物理，铺好气旋再接主攻。
objective.en: Color Physical, establish Cyclone, then return to the main attacker.

title.zh: 柚叶续增益，交给主攻染物理
title.en: Refresh Yuzuha buffs and let the main attacker color Physical

input.zh: 普通切柚叶，能量够时点按EX；命中后按实际主攻入场提示。
input.en: Switch normally to Yuzuha and tap an affordable EX; take the actual main-attacker entry prompt after the hit.

trigger.zh: 开局或增益／甜蜜惊吓需要刷新；不是每个循环都重放。
trigger.en: At opening or when buffs/Sweet Scare need refresh; do not recast every loop.

complete.zh: EX发动获得2糖点，重击挂甜蜜惊吓、命中给快支；重挂会清掉旧染色，让主攻下一次物理命中重新染色。
complete.en: EX activation grants two Sugar Points; its heavy hit applies Sweet Scare and its hit prompts Quick Assist. Reapplication clears old color, so the main attacker recolors with a Physical hit.

reason.zh: 固定站位使柚叶下一位和维琳娜上一位都是同一主攻。
reason.en: The cyclic order makes the same main attacker next after Yuzuha and previous before Velina.

fallback.zh: 能量不足且原增益仍在就普通回主攻继续；已就绪的柚叶Q也能续惊吓，但须重染，不能视为免费EX。
fallback.en: If energy is short and buffs remain, switch normally back to the main attacker. A ready Yuzuha Ultimate can refresh Sweet Scare but also needs recoloring; it is not a free EX.

signal.zh: 只响应主攻实际快支或连携，择一入场。
signal.en: Take the main attacker’s actual Quick Assist or Chain, exactly once.

title.zh: 按提示接主攻并确认物理命中
title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

input.zh: 按当前形态响应快支；若出现真实连携窗口则选择主攻连携。只执行一种入场。
input.en: Take the Quick Assist matching the current form; if an actual Chain window appears, choose the main attacker’s Chain. Execute one entry only.

trigger.zh: 提示确实指向爱丽丝；柚叶2影强制连携仍须真实提示。
trigger.en: The prompt really targets Alice; even Yuzuha M2 forced Chain requires a real prompt.

complete.zh: 物理命中建立／维持染色并按真实命中积攒剑仪；连携不额外赠送200剑仪。
complete.en: A Physical hit establishes/maintains color and builds actual Sword Etiquette on hits; Chain does not grant 200 extra points.

reason.zh: 普通切人、不同快支形态和连携分开处理，强制连携不等于敌人失衡。
reason.en: Keep normal switches, Quick Assist forms and Chain distinct; a forced Chain does not mean the enemy is Stunned.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就普通切主攻，用合法物理攻击继续，并跳过此入场动作。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally to the main attacker, use a legal Physical attack and skip this entry move.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援（当前形态）／连携：择一
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

signal.zh: 物理命中后普通切维琳娜准备气旋。
signal.en: After the Physical hit, switch normally to Velina for Cyclone setup.

title.zh: 缺风华才用扬清补，能量与风华分开看
title.en: Use Purifying Rise if Windbloom is short; track energy separately

input.zh: 普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按EX三重绝息。
input.en: After normal entry or a valid Defensive Assist, tap an affordable Purifying Rise. If more is needed and energy permits, follow it with Triple Deathblow.

trigger.zh: 准备释放风暴眼而风华不足90；现有风华够时可省略补充。
trigger.en: Eye of the Storm is needed but Windbloom is below 90; skip replenishing when it already suffices.

complete.zh: 扬清／三重绝息发动各加45风华，上限135；开战基础45。看当前风华，不用能量条冒充。
complete.en: Each Purifying Rise/Triple Deathblow activation gives 45 Windbloom, cap 135, with 45 at baseline battle entry. Read Windbloom, not the energy bar.

reason.zh: 原文口语中的“90能量”不当成风暴眼门槛；当前固定技能明确要求90风华。
reason.en: Do not treat the article’s shorthand “90 energy” as the gate: the fixed skill explicitly requires 90 Windbloom.

fallback.zh: 缺能量且风华不足就普通切主攻继续正常积蓄，下一步风暴眼与快支一起跳过；已有90风华也先普通切到维琳娜，仅跳过补EX，再接下一步。
fallback.en: If energy and Windbloom are both short, switch normally to the main attacker and skip the next Cyclone/assist segment. With 90 Windbloom already, still switch normally to Velina; skip only the refill EX and proceed.

title.zh: 风华够90再开风暴眼，回支主攻
title.en: At 90 Windbloom, summon the Cyclone and assist back

input.zh: 确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。
input.en: Confirm at least 90 Windbloom, hold Special or Basic for Eye of the Storm, then take the main attacker’s actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 维琳娜已在前场且风华满足；气旋已够用时别无脑重复覆盖。
trigger.en: Velina is active with sufficient Windbloom; avoid overwriting adequate Cyclone coverage unnecessarily.

complete.zh: 生成广域气旋并触发上一位主攻快支；首次命中浸染目标才确认赋彩，普通命中不等于已有风异常。
complete.en: Summon Sweeping Cyclone and trigger the previous main attacker’s Quick Assist. Chromatic Tint requires its first hit on a Contaminated enemy; an ordinary hit does not prove Wind Anomaly.

reason.zh: 交棒后气旋在实际持续时间内继续作用；0影赋彩不直接按2影的对应属性积蓄计算。
reason.en: The Cyclone continues for its actual duration after the handoff. At M0, do not count the corresponding-attribute buildup added by M2.

fallback.zh: 风华不够回上步恢复；已不需重放可普通切主攻并跳过提示动作。赋彩不符先检查目标实际浸染。
fallback.en: If Windbloom is insufficient, recover first. If recasting is unnecessary, switch normally and skip prompt entry. For wrong tint, inspect actual Contamination.

signal.zh: 维琳娜上一位主攻：真实快支／连携提示二选一。
signal.en: Previous main attacker before Velina: choose one actual Quick Assist or Chain prompt.

title.zh: 按提示接主攻并确认物理命中
title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

title.zh: 满三格再三蓄，终结命中打极性强击
title.en: Triple-charge three stocked bars; land the finisher for Polarity Assault

input.zh: 300剑仪时长按普攻，消耗全部三格；让三段招式终结一击命中。
input.en: At 300 Sword Etiquette, hold Basic through all three bars; land the three-stage finisher.

trigger.zh: 实际300剑仪且目标可命中；靠近物理异常触发点时按敌人当前状态择机。
trigger.en: Actual 300 Sword Etiquette and a hittable target; time around the current Physical buildup state when useful.

complete.zh: 三段蓄力已消耗完；终结命中才触发极性强击；此招命中不回剑仪。
complete.en: All three charge stages have been consumed; Polarity Assault requires the finisher hit; hits from this move do not restore Sword Etiquette.

reason.zh: 把资源、终结命中与实际异常结算分开，不虚构固定伤害次数。
reason.en: Separate stock, finisher hit and actual Anomaly resolutions; do not invent a fixed damage-event count.

fallback.zh: 不足300且窗口不足就用当前合法攻击收尾，不把一／二蓄标成三蓄极性。
fallback.en: If stock/time is short, finish with a legal available move; do not label a one/two-stage charge as triple-charge Polarity.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

prep.zh: 辅助EX按当前能量；不假定开局全员满能量，能量不足先正常积蓄。
prep.en: Support EX uses current energy; do not assume everyone starts full. Recover normally if short.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 维护气旋与主攻资源，用已确认节点交棒。
objective.en: Maintain Cyclone and main-attacker resources, using confirmed handoff cues.

title.zh: 常态中立／后退EX打南十字
title.en: Use neutral/backward EX South Cross outside Stun

input.zh: 不输入方向或向后输入，再点按EX。
input.en: Use neutral or backward input and tap EX.

trigger.zh: 实际能量足够；常态输出或补剑仪；只在真实敌人攻击时才可能极限闪避。
trigger.en: Enough actual energy; normal output or Sword Etiquette recovery; Perfect Dodge requires a real incoming attack.

complete.zh: 发动直接回复10剑仪，命中再按核心积累；不要求先极限闪避，也不把一次EX算固定回100。
complete.en: Activation directly restores 10 Sword Etiquette, with further accumulation from actual hits. Perfect Dodge is not required, and one EX is not a fixed 100-point refill.

reason.zh: 采用作者常态南十字／失衡北十字的输入分工，机制与回资源按当前固定源。
reason.en: Use the author’s South-outside/North-during-Stun input preference, with mechanics/resource recovery from the fixed source.

fallback.zh: 无能量用普攻／合法闪反；若已有300剑仪可直接三蓄，缺资源不硬挤一次EX。
fallback.en: Without energy, use Basic/legal Dodge Counters. With 300 Sword Etiquette already, triple-charge directly rather than forcing another EX.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

title.zh: 看剑仪与物理槽补齐三蓄
title.en: Build Sword Etiquette while watching Physical buildup

input.zh: 点按普攻命中积攒；真实极限闪避后可用闪反。
input.en: Tap Basic for hits; use a legal Dodge Counter after an actual Perfect Dodge.

trigger.zh: 剑仪不足300，或正在等待合适的物理积蓄进度。
trigger.en: Sword Etiquette is below 300 or a useful Physical buildup state is being prepared.

complete.zh: 满300才具备三段蓄力库存；通过积蓄触发强击会强化下一次普五，只有真实紊乱才按额外能力回30。
complete.en: At 300, three charge stages are stocked. Assault through buildup enhances the next fifth Basic; only actual Disorder grants the additional-ability 30 points.

reason.zh: 乱流不直接当紊乱回剑仪；三蓄与Q命中也不会额外按普通命中回剑仪。
reason.en: Vortex is not automatically Disorder for Sword recovery; charged attacks/Ultimate hits do not grant ordinary on-hit Sword accumulation.

fallback.zh: 已300就跳过积攒；物理槽卡在异常冷却时先调整节奏，不承诺三蓄必同时触发多种结算。
fallback.en: Skip buildup at 300. If Physical buildup is blocked by an Anomaly cooldown, adjust timing; triple charge does not guarantee multiple simultaneous resolutions.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

title.zh: 满三格蓄力，消失后才可交棒
title.en: Charge all three bars; hand off only after the disappearance cue

input.zh: 300剑仪时长按普攻，消耗全部三格；完成三段蓄力、爱丽丝身形消失后普通切维琳娜。
input.en: At 300 Sword Etiquette, hold Basic through all three bars; after all three charge stages and Alice’s disappearance cue, switch normally to Velina.

trigger.zh: 实际300剑仪且目标可命中；靠近物理异常触发点时按敌人当前状态择机。
trigger.en: Actual 300 Sword Etiquette and a hittable target; time around the current Physical buildup state when useful.

complete.zh: 三段蓄力已消耗完；消失提示后可切，终结命中才结算极性强击。
complete.en: All three charge stages have been consumed; switch after the disappearance cue, while Polarity Assault still requires the finisher to hit.

reason.zh: 作者明确提供消失后的脱手节点；不是长按开始就可切，也不承诺每次三蓄固定多次乱流。
reason.en: The author identifies the disappearance cue for off-field continuation, not the start of holding. No fixed Vortex count is promised.

fallback.zh: 不足300先正常补剑仪；若维琳娜急需刷新，可普通切维并省略三蓄及其后台重叠。
fallback.en: Below 300, build normally. If Velina urgently needs a refresh, switch normally and omit both triple charge and its overlap.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。

signal.zh: 三段已释放且出现消失提示后普通切维琳娜。
signal.en: Switch normally to Velina after all three stages release and the disappearance cue appears.

label.en: Only after all three charges release and the disappearance-cue handoff, Alice continues her attack.

title.en: At 90 Windbloom, summon the Cyclone and assist back

title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

input.zh: 按当前形态响应快支；若出现真实连携窗口则选择主攻连携。只执行一种入场。
input.en: Take the Quick Assist matching the current form; if an actual Chain window appears, choose the main attacker’s Chain. Execute one entry only.

trigger.zh: 提示确实指向爱丽丝；柚叶2影强制连携仍须真实提示。
trigger.en: The prompt really targets Alice; even Yuzuha M2 forced Chain requires a real prompt.

complete.zh: 物理命中建立／维持染色并按真实命中积攒剑仪；连携不额外赠送200剑仪。
complete.en: A Physical hit establishes/maintains color and builds actual Sword Etiquette on hits; Chain does not grant 200 extra points.

reason.zh: 普通切人、不同快支形态和连携分开处理，强制连携不等于敌人失衡。
reason.en: Keep normal switches, Quick Assist forms and Chain distinct; a forced Chain does not mean the enemy is Stunned.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就普通切主攻，用合法物理攻击继续，并跳过此入场动作。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally to the main attacker, use a legal Physical attack and skip this entry move.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援（当前形态）／连携：择一
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

prep.zh: 柚叶增益或惊吓需刷新才回开局前两步，重挂后主攻重新染物理。
prep.en: Return to the first two opening events only when Yuzuha coverage/Sweet Scare needs refresh, then recolor Physical.

prep.zh: 没有补气旋需求就留主攻，不强制每轮完整换人；气旋不足但无合法黄光时普通切维并跳过招架。
prep.en: Stay on the main attacker if Cyclone needs no refresh; if it does and no legal flash exists, switch normally to Velina and skip the parry.

prep.zh: 有实际黄光与支援点也可招架切维；仅普通三蓄消失节点按本阶段重叠说明。
prep.en: A real parryable flash and Assist Points also allow Defensive Assist to Velina; this phase’s documented overlap specifically uses the triple-charge disappearance cue.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 提前完成辅助准备，按现有资源输出。
objective.en: Prepare support before the window, then spend actual available resources.

title.zh: 缺风华才用扬清补，能量与风华分开看
title.en: Use Purifying Rise if Windbloom is short; track energy separately

input.zh: 普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按EX三重绝息。
input.en: After normal entry or a valid Defensive Assist, tap an affordable Purifying Rise. If more is needed and energy permits, follow it with Triple Deathblow.

trigger.zh: 准备释放风暴眼而风华不足90；现有风华够时可省略补充。
trigger.en: Eye of the Storm is needed but Windbloom is below 90; skip replenishing when it already suffices.

complete.zh: 扬清／三重绝息发动各加45风华，上限135；开战基础45。看当前风华，不用能量条冒充。
complete.en: Each Purifying Rise/Triple Deathblow activation gives 45 Windbloom, cap 135, with 45 at baseline battle entry. Read Windbloom, not the energy bar.

reason.zh: 原文口语中的“90能量”不当成风暴眼门槛；当前固定技能明确要求90风华。
reason.en: Do not treat the article’s shorthand “90 energy” as the gate: the fixed skill explicitly requires 90 Windbloom.

fallback.zh: 缺能量且风华不足就普通切主攻继续正常积蓄，下一步风暴眼与快支一起跳过；已有90风华也先普通切到维琳娜，仅跳过补EX，再接下一步。
fallback.en: If energy and Windbloom are both short, switch normally to the main attacker and skip the next Cyclone/assist segment. With 90 Windbloom already, still switch normally to Velina; skip only the refill EX and proceed.

title.zh: 风华够90再开风暴眼，回支主攻
title.en: At 90 Windbloom, summon the Cyclone and assist back

input.zh: 确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。
input.en: Confirm at least 90 Windbloom, hold Special or Basic for Eye of the Storm, then take the main attacker’s actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 维琳娜已在前场且风华满足；气旋已够用时别无脑重复覆盖。
trigger.en: Velina is active with sufficient Windbloom; avoid overwriting adequate Cyclone coverage unnecessarily.

complete.zh: 生成广域气旋并触发上一位主攻快支；首次命中浸染目标才确认赋彩，普通命中不等于已有风异常。
complete.en: Summon Sweeping Cyclone and trigger the previous main attacker’s Quick Assist. Chromatic Tint requires its first hit on a Contaminated enemy; an ordinary hit does not prove Wind Anomaly.

reason.zh: 交棒后气旋在实际持续时间内继续作用；0影赋彩不直接按2影的对应属性积蓄计算。
reason.en: The Cyclone continues for its actual duration after the handoff. At M0, do not count the corresponding-attribute buildup added by M2.

fallback.zh: 风华不够回上步恢复；已不需重放可普通切主攻并跳过提示动作。赋彩不符先检查目标实际浸染。
fallback.en: If Windbloom is insufficient, recover first. If recasting is unnecessary, switch normally and skip prompt entry. For wrong tint, inspect actual Contamination.

signal.zh: 维琳娜上一位主攻：真实快支／连携提示二选一。
signal.en: Previous main attacker before Velina: choose one actual Quick Assist or Chain prompt.

title.zh: 按提示接主攻并确认物理命中
title.en: Enter on the actual prompt and confirm a Physical hit

fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally to the main attacker, use a legal Physical attack and skip this entry move.

actionLabel.en: Quick Assist (current form) / Chain: choose one

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

title.zh: 失衡窗口向前EX打北十字
title.en: Use forward EX North Cross in the Stun window

trigger.zh: 实际能量足够；敌人已失衡且仍有输出窗口。
trigger.en: Enough actual energy; the enemy is really Stunned with time remaining.

complete.zh: 发动直接回复10剑仪，命中再按核心积累；不要求先极限闪避，也不把一次EX算固定回100。
complete.en: Activation directly restores 10 Sword Etiquette, with further accumulation from actual hits. Perfect Dodge is not required, and one EX is not a fixed 100-point refill.

reason.zh: 采用作者常态南十字／失衡北十字的输入分工，机制与回资源按当前固定源。
reason.en: Use the author’s South-outside/North-during-Stun input preference, with mechanics/resource recovery from the fixed source.

fallback.zh: 无能量用普攻／合法闪反；若已有300剑仪可直接三蓄，缺资源不硬挤一次EX。
fallback.en: Without energy, use Basic/legal Dodge Counters. With 300 Sword Etiquette already, triple-charge directly rather than forcing another EX.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

title.en: Use a ready Ultimate for the actual 200-point Sword gap

input.zh: 本人Q已就绪、剑仪有补充空间时按Q；已满三格先用三蓄，不强行溢出。
input.en: Use Alice’s ready Ultimate when there is room for Sword Etiquette. If all three bars are full, spend them first rather than forcing overflow.

trigger.zh: Q实际就绪且输出窗口仍有效；不是所有进场都已有Q。
trigger.en: Her own Ultimate is actually ready with useful window remaining; not every entry starts with it ready.

complete.zh: 发动直接回复200剑仪，上限300；招式命中不另外累积剑仪，0影Q不自带极性强击。
complete.en: Activation restores 200 Sword Etiquette up to 300. Its hits do not add further Sword Etiquette, and M0 Ultimate does not itself trigger Polarity Assault.

reason.zh: 200只补两格，原库存仍决定下一次能否三蓄。
reason.en: Two bars of recovery do not guarantee a triple charge; the prior stock still matters.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪或无缺口就跳过；Q后仍不足300则正常补齐，窗口太短用合法攻击收尾。
fallback.en: Skip if unready or no refill is needed. If still below 300 afterwards, build normally or finish with a legal move when time is short.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

title.zh: 满三格再三蓄，终结命中打极性强击
title.en: Triple-charge three stocked bars; land the finisher for Polarity Assault

input.zh: 300剑仪时长按普攻，消耗全部三格；让三段招式终结一击命中。
input.en: At 300 Sword Etiquette, hold Basic through all three bars; land the three-stage finisher.

trigger.zh: 实际300剑仪且目标可命中；靠近物理异常触发点时按敌人当前状态择机。
trigger.en: Actual 300 Sword Etiquette and a hittable target; time around the current Physical buildup state when useful.

complete.zh: 三段蓄力已消耗完；终结命中才触发极性强击；此招命中不回剑仪。
complete.en: All three charge stages have been consumed; Polarity Assault requires the finisher hit; hits from this move do not restore Sword Etiquette.

reason.zh: 把资源、终结命中与实际异常结算分开，不虚构固定伤害次数。
reason.en: Separate stock, finisher hit and actual Anomaly resolutions; do not invent a fixed damage-event count.

fallback.zh: 不足300且窗口不足就用当前合法攻击收尾，不把一／二蓄标成三蓄极性。
fallback.en: If stock/time is short, finish with a legal available move; do not label a one/two-stage charge as triple-charge Polarity.

label.zh: 柚叶已染物理的糖衣效果按实际覆盖持续。
label.en: Yuzuha’s Physical-colored Sugarcoat persists for its actual coverage.

label.zh: 气旋仅在实际存续期间继续攻击；未凭空刷新。
label.en: Cyclone keeps attacking only for its actual remaining duration; no automatic refresh.

prep.zh: 柚叶增益、物理染色与气旋尽量在失衡前准备好；已覆盖就省略维琳娜准备和对应快支，留主攻。
prep.en: Prepare Yuzuha buffs, Physical color and Cyclone before Stun when possible; if already covered, skip Velina setup and its assist, staying on the main attacker.

prep.zh: 留意剑仪300上限；已有三格先三蓄再考虑Q补，Q只回200，不保证再一次三蓄。窗口不足就缩短。
prep.en: Respect the 300 Sword cap. Spend a full triple charge before considering Ultimate recovery; its 200 points do not guarantee another triple charge. Shorten when time is limited.

prep.zh: 连携只按实际提示，不把柚2强制连携当真实失衡；不保证相同Boss或金数下固定次数。
prep.en: Use only actual Chain prompts. Yuzuha M2 forced Chain is not real Stun; no fixed count is promised across bosses or investment levels.

text.zh: 柚1开战加能量不等于每轮免费EX；仍看能量是否够用。
text.en: Yuzuha M1 starting energy is not a free EX every loop; check actual affordability.

text.zh: 柚2重击命中非失衡敌人可按20秒间隔强制连携；快支与连携按真实提示择一，强制连携不是失衡。
text.en: Yuzuha M2 can force a Chain on a heavy hit against a non-Stunned enemy with a 20s cooldown. Choose the actual assist/Chain prompt; forced Chain is not Stun.

text.zh: 维1提高气旋失衡与对应抗性穿透，可能提前进失衡；资源准备未满时不硬套同一秒轴。
text.en: Velina M1 improves Cyclone Daze and specified RES ignoring; Stun may arrive earlier, so do not assume an unchanged timed resource schedule.

text.zh: 维2风化也能回风蚀（5秒间隔），赋彩气旋才增加对应属性积蓄；该额外积蓄不参与异常伤害结算。
text.en: Velina M2 also grants Windbite from Windswept with a 5s cooldown, and tinted Cyclones gain matching-attribute buildup excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations.

text.zh: 维6消耗2风蚀后返1受6秒间隔限制；别把每次乱流都当气旋或返还。
text.en: Velina M6 refunding one after spending two Windbite has a 6s cooldown; not every Vortex summons a Cyclone or refunds.

text.zh: 维专武需两次EX招式造成风伤才叠到2层、给全队精通；同一招多次命中最多记1层。
text.en: Velina’s signature needs Wind damage from two EX uses to reach two stacks and grant team AP; repeated hits within one move count once.

text.zh: 柚专武的全队精通要追加攻击实际命中；有装备不等于增益已生效。
text.en: Yuzuha’s signature team AP needs an actual Aftershock hit; equipping it alone does not activate the buff.

text.zh: 爱丽丝1极性强击回25剑仪，触发强击挂减防；只按真实触发回收，不能当每个伤害段回25。
text.en: Alice M1 restores 25 Sword Etiquette on Polarity Assault and applies DEF reduction on Assault. Restore only on the actual trigger, not every damage hit.

text.zh: 爱丽丝2让Q终结命中触发极性强击；开战1000喧响不等于Q就绪，Q仍由本人喧响决定。
text.en: Alice M2 adds Polarity Assault to the Ultimate finisher hit. The starting 1000 Decibels are not a ready Ultimate; check her own gauge.

text.zh: 爱丽丝4强化已经满足条件的强化普攻积蓄；不把任意普五直接视为强化普五。
text.en: Alice M4 improves the already-qualified enhanced Basic buildup; not every fifth Basic is automatically enhanced.

text.zh: 爱丽丝6发动三蓄或Q进入决胜；队伍命中才追击，1秒间隔且最多6次，再次获得状态刷新次数。
text.en: Alice M6 enters Victory State on triple-charge or Ultimate activation. Squad hits trigger follow-ups with a 1s cooldown and six-use cap; reactivation refreshes the count.

text.zh: 爱丽丝专武进入接战立即获得两层；后续由强击刷新，不需要为开场叠层硬等两次强击。
text.en: Alice’s signature starts combat with two stacks, then refreshes through Assault. Do not force two opening Assaults solely to establish the buff.

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。: 确认风华至少90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼；看到主攻的入场提示再接。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切柚叶，能量够时点按EX；命中后按实际主攻入场提示。: 柚叶普通入场后，能量够时点按强化特殊技；命中后看主攻实际出现的入场提示。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按当前形态响应快支；若出现真实连携窗口则选择主攻连携。只执行一种入场。: 出现主攻的快支提示就按对应支援键；若是连携选人窗口则选主攻。两种入场只执行一种，不需要重复切人。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.不输入方向或向后输入，再点按EX。: 不输入方向或向后输入，同时点按强化特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.点按普攻命中积攒；真实极限闪避后可用闪反。: 点按普攻命中积攒剑仪。成功极限闪避后，可以点普攻反击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.向前输入并点按EX。: 向前输入，同时点按强化特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.本人Q已就绪、剑仪有补充空间时按Q；已满三格先用三蓄，不强行溢出。: 终结技就绪、剑仪还有补充空间时按终结技；已经满三格就先长按普攻打三段蓄力，避免溢出。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1401: 点按普攻积攒剑仪；能量足够时也可向前按强化特殊技。满三格才长按普攻打三蓄。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.141100008: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，让炸弹命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.141100015: 终结技就绪时按终结技，等命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.156100005: 风华至少90时长按特殊技或普攻，发动风暴眼

140100001: 普攻是本步积剑仪的方式，按目标资源决定何时停；要触发第五段效果才打到第五段。
Use Basics here for Sword Etiquette; stop when the resource target is reached. Hit 5 is needed only for its own effect.
140100002: 满三格时长按普攻蓄到第三阶段；这是持续按住的蓄力，不是普攻连续点三下。
At three gauges, hold Basic to charge level 3. This is a held charge, not three taps.
140100010: 终结技不用先按普攻；仅在剑仪已满、要避免溢出时，先长按普攻打完三段蓄力。
No Basic required before Ultimate. Only spend a full gauge with a charged Basic first if needed to avoid overcapping.

1401: 需要剑仪可用普攻积攒或有能量时用强化特殊技；满三格后才长按普攻三蓄。
Build gauge with Basics or EX with sufficient Energy. Only then, at three gauges, hold Basic for the full charge.

156100003: 强化特殊技：风切变·扬清
EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise
156100004: 强化特殊技：风切变·三重绝息
EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow
